ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course begins June 30th and ends August 21st. The course includes three face-to-face (site-based) meetings that will be held at the UIC College of Medicine, 1 Illini Drive, Peoria, IL. The first face-to-face class meeting is scheduled for Tuesday evening, July 1st in room A100-2 from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The dates and times for the remaining site-based meetings have not yet been determined.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $349.00 per Bill Hour, and Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
